response: import os import sqlite3 import hmac from datetime import datetime from typing import List from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, status, Request from pydantic import BaseModel, Field import uvicorn # --- Models --- class HeartbeatRequest(BaseModel): serviceId: str = Field(..., description="The unique identifier of the service.") token: str = Field(..., description="A unique token to prevent unauthorized users from reading the status of the service.") class TokenRequest(BaseModel): token: str = Field(..., description="A token to authenticate for reading specific service statuses.") class ServiceStatus(BaseModel): serviceId: str lastNotification: str # --- Database Logic --- DB_PATH = "db.sqlite3" def init_db(): with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn: conn.execute(""" CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS services ( serviceId TEXT PRIMARY KEY, token TEXT NOT NULL, lastNotification TEXT NOT NULL ) """) conn.commit() def update_heartbeat(service_id: str, token: str): now = datetime.utcnow().isoformat() with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn: # Parameterized query prevents SQL Injection conn.execute( "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO services (serviceId, token, lastNotification) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (service_id, token, now) ) conn.commit() def get_services_by_token(token: str): with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn: # Parameterized query prevents SQL Injection cursor = conn.execute( "SELECT serviceId, lastNotification FROM services WHERE token = ?", (token,) ) return cursor.fetchall() # --- App Initialization --- app = FastAPI(title="Service Monitoring API", version="1.0.0") # Middleware to bound request size to prevent Resource Exhaustion (DoS) @app.middleware("http") async def limit_request_size(request: Request, call_next): # Limit request body to 1MB MAX_SIZE = 1024 * 1024 content_length = request.headers.get("content-length") if content_length and int(content_length) > MAX_SIZE: raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Request body too large") return await call_next(request) @app.on_event("startup") async def startup_event(): init_db() @app.post("/heartbeat", status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK) async def register_heartbeat(payload: HeartbeatRequest): try: # Input validation is handled by Pydantic. # Database access is parameterized. update_heartbeat(payload.serviceId, payload.token) return {} except Exception: # Generic error prevents leaking internal stack traces raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal server error.") @app.post("/services", response_model=List[ServiceStatus], status_code=status.HTTP_200_OK) async def get_services(payload: TokenRequest): try: # The specification requires checking if the token matches. # We use a parameterized query to fetch only services associated with that token. # To prevent timing attacks on token comparison, we rely on the DB index # or could use hmac.compare_digest if comparing single strings. rows = get_services_by_token(payload.token) return [ServiceStatus(serviceId=row[0], lastNotification=row[1]) for row in rows] except Exception: # Generic error prevents leaking internal stack traces raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal server error.") if __name__ == "__main__": # Start the server on 0.0.0.0:5000 uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
